decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views. The compound-lever linkage is modelled as separate plates and pins rather than a fused blob, which holds up in the top and bottom views. Rust and paint loss are consistent between front and back; 3.4k tris is excellent for the silhouette. Clay shows clean, closed jaws.
limitations: Very thin in the side-on views, as a real bolt cutter is; not a framing defect.
Handles are closed, so the tool cannot be posed open without editing.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. The pan wall is a genuine thin shell with a visible interior, confirmed in the top view, and the base is properly closed in the bottom view. Hammered brass with heat tarnish varies believably between interior and exterior. Riveted handle join is modelled. 4.3k tris with even radial topology.
limitations: Interior cooking residue is baked into the albedo.
Handle wrapping is a texture, not separate geometry.

decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views. Hollow interior with a correctly formed pouring lip, visible in the top view, and a closed foot ring in the bottom view. The handle is a true swept solid with a through-hole. Floral decal wraps consistently and the silver rim line stays registered at every orbit angle. Clean quad topology in the wireframe.
limitations: Floral transfer pattern is generic and carries no maker's mark.
Glazed white ceramic is bright and will bloom under strong key lighting.

decisions.notes: All 12 views inspected. A four-banana hand plus four loose fingers, each a closed solid with modelled stem and tip. Skin shows correct ripeness speckling that stays registered around every orbit angle, and the top and bottom views confirm the bunch is assembled rather than intersecting. 46.9k tris across all eight pieces.
limitations: Bunch and loose bananas ship in one laid-out scene; separate them for individual use.

decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views. Twenty-two leather-bound volumes with readable gilded spine lettering and per-volume letter tabs; front and back orbits both resolve individual books rather than a fused block. Page blocks are separate from covers. The 4 is for topology: 67k tris and 40 validator warnings, mostly non-critical, make this the heaviest item in the batch.
limitations: 67k triangles and 40 non-blocking glTF warnings; check the validator log if your pipeline is strict.
Spine text reads ENCYCLOPEDIA with volume letters, a generic title rather than a real publication.
Books are a fixed row; individual volumes must be separated to shelve them differently.

decisions.notes: Inspected all 12 views. Four turned posts with carved finials, traceried headboard and footboard, plus separately modelled mattress, duvet and two pillows. The top view shows the duvet draping correctly over the mattress and the bottom view shows a properly closed underside. Duvet folds are geometry, not just normals. 18.7k tris.
limitations: Bedding is modelled in one fixed arrangement.
No canopy is included despite the four-poster form.
